facts.fact: Morocco World News reports citizens filed 163,694 complaints against public administrations through the national Chikaya.ma platform in 2025, and that it was launched in 2018.

Morocco World News reports 1,747 public administrations take part in Chikaya.ma, including 38 government departments, 116 public institutions and 1,590 territorial communities, with 45,298 complaints to ministries and 15,658 to territorial communities in 2025.
Morocco World News reports Chikaya.ma processed 66.14% of 2025 complaints, with a 58.69% satisfaction rate, an average processing time of 16 days and more than 14,000 cases reopened.
